notes.title: Racing Tanks! v1.3 - Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
One year ago, I released the full version of Racing Tanks here on Steam. It was a really emotional moment for me, as not only I finally finished the game that I've been working for years at that time and could consider myself a true Game Developer, but also because I was on a really dark but important time in my life, so the release of this game meant a lot to me at that moment.

A lot has happened in a year, so to celebrate this special day, not only the game is going to be on discount for a week (perfect to gift to your friends!), but also I added two new game modes!


Key: Find the Key scattered in the map, and use it to reach the goal, but if your opponent grabbed it before you, destroy him so they can grab de Key!
Tower: There's an evil control tower in the map, preventing anyone to access the goal. Team up with your rival to destroy this tower! But don't forget that you're still enemies!


I also added some quality of life features that will make your gameplay a little bit more enjoyable:


Now your character will show an icon at the start of the round, so you won't have to be searching for it as much!

Now the Race mode will have the goal locked for 5 seconds at the beginning of the round, so if the goal was placed right in front of your enemy, you still have time to turn the tables!

Some of the Power Ups now show its icon and time left right on your tank! It was hard to tell if your enemy had a shield right away if you weren't looking at their stats.

Other minor visual improvements (now bullets have an impact effect).

Bug Fixes (of course there's always bugs)


I hope that you enjoy this update with your friends, and thank you so much for playing my game!

Skyty says Hi and sends you a big hug, Darkar says nothing...

ManuEcheveste
